summary: cart show (alias cart list) reads UserCart for the active cart and prices items with Items hydration: quantity, unit price, line total, estimated subtotal; per-lb items are marked estimate; unpriced items are counted in a note. Read-only.
reason: There was no way to see cart contents with prices; UserCart carries names and quantities only.
validated_outcome: Stub test: three items (each, weight, unpriced) give $3.49 x2 = $6.98, $10.00/lb x1.5 = $15.00 estimate, subtotal $21.98 and a note for the unpriced item; the list alias works. Read-only live check against an empty cart: 0 items, $0.00.
review_fixes: PR #2320 review: multi-buy labels ("2 for $5") give the per-unit price and are marked estimate instead of treating the deal price as the unit price.
